prose: MonoCode is a GUI for coding agents, with a Mac download and a GitHub repo showing 2.4K stars. The page lists the agents it fronts: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Antigravity and others. Basis: the page text was very short, so this covers only that pitch.
highlights: GUI that wraps several coding agents.
Mac download; GitHub repo at 2.4K stars.
